children: Pacific Health Care Organization reported 2026 nine-month revenue of $1.51M, down 4.7% from the prior-year period, while net income increased 50% to $334.61K and diluted EPS rose to $0.03 from $0.02.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share amount”.
Nine-month revenue declined 7%, as losses among HCO and MPN customers outweighed growth in medical bill review and utilization review.
Utilization review revenue rose 12%, driven by higher rates and more treatment-authorization referrals from existing customers.
Medical bill review revenue increased 17%, reflecting a greater share of higher-priced hospital bill reviews.

Customer terminations and reduced referrals weighed on HCO, MPN and case management. The company expects new programs and expanded services for existing customers, along with third-quarter labor reductions, to partly offset the impact.
